description: A React component that displays and manages a list of tasks, including search, categorization, drag-and-drop reordering, and task actions.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles clicking the task menu button, setting anchor element and position for context menu.

methods.name: reorderTasks
methods.description: Reorders tasks based on category, search, sort option, and done status.

methods.name: confirmDeleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the selected task and updates user state.

methods.name: handleMarkSelectedAsDone
methods.description: Marks multiple selected tasks as done.

methods.name: handleDeleteSelected
methods.description: Opens confirmation dialog to delete multiple selected tasks.

methods.name: checkOverdueTasks
methods.description: Checks for overdue tasks and shows a toast notification.

methods.name: handleDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a drag-and-drop operation, updating task order.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag operation, setting active drag ID.
